hooks.command: FILE_PATH=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$' && [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/tsc" ]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; fi
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && echo '=== Git Status ===' && git status --short 2>/dev/null && echo '' && echo '=== Progress ===' && cat docs/progress.md 2>/dev/null || echo 'progress.md not found'
